topic.title: Extension of the program
topic.text:
Dear participant, 

Given the fact that many of you have requested extra time to complete your assignments, we have agreed to extend the program until May 10th, 2022 at 5:59 pm EDT (Boston, Massachusetts) / 11:59 pm CEST (Central European Summer Time). 

We have been following your progress with great interest and are pleased to see your commitment and the quality of your work increase week by week.  

We would like to remind you that the activities' deadlines will not be changed. However, with the program extension, you will be able to hand in all pending assignments and take part in forums. Your learning facilitator will evaluate all activities submitted as soon as possible. 

We would also like to take this opportunity to remind you of the necessary steps to obtain your Certificate of Completion: 

  1. Fill in the initial survey, which you must have completed before starting the program. 
  1. Complete 80% of the assignments and forums of the program. 

We are at your disposal for any questions or comments you may have.  

Please feel free to reach us at any time. 

Kind regards, 

The MIT Professional Education Program Team at Global Alumni
